en: Chapter on Mindfulness, 2. The Question on Omniscience
“Venerable Nāgasena, is the Buddha omniscient and all-seeing?
“Yes, Great King, the Blessed One is omniscient and all-seeing.”
“But why, venerable Nāgasena, did you lay down the training rules for your disciples gradually?
“Now, Great King, is there any physician who knows all the medicines on this earth?
“Great king, does that physician administer medicine to the sick man when the time has arrived, or when the time has not yet arrived?
“When the time has arrived, venerable sir; he administers medicine to the sick man, not when the time has not yet arrived.

“In the same way, great king, the Blessed One, the All-Knowing and All-Seeing, does not lay down a training rule for his disciples when the time has not yet arrived; he lays down a training rule for his disciples only when the time has arrived, to be observed for as long as life lasts and not to be transgressed.”
Thus ends the second chapter, the Question on Omniscience.
